prose: Bloomberg reports, according to Techmeme, that Munich-based Agile Robots raised $500 million in a SoftBank-led round at an $8.5 billion valuation. The company develops humanoids, mobile robots, arms and control software. The original article was unavailable, so the item does not establish deployment scale or the detailed terms of the investment.
highlights: SoftBank is named as lead investor
Product range spans hardware and control software
basis: Techmeme headline and excerpt; Bloomberg source fetch failed.
